title: MusicDrop v1.7.0 — TV Mode Available
changelog:
• NEW: TV Mode — Install on Android TV or Fire TV for a full remote-controlled music experience with D-pad navigation, full-screen player, spinning vinyl art, and genre browsing
• TV Chooser: First TV launch shows a beautiful mode selector — choose 'TV Mode' for the optimized 10-foot UI or 'Music Mode' for the full mobile interface
• TV Home: Hero now-playing banner + horizontal genre rows (India Trending, Malayalam, Tamil, Lofi) all navigable with the TV remote
• TV Player: Spinning vinyl album art, large seek bar, and full D-pad remote controls (← prev / → next / OK play-pause / ↑ +10s / ↓ -10s)
• TV Browse & Search: Genre sidebar + 3-column results grid, all remote-friendly with glowing focus rings
• Mobile version unchanged — zero risk, same great experience on phones
